description:
General Information
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Rubber Seal for the Hardtop.
Seals the Hardtop where it joins against the Targa Bar
55″ Long
See # 11 on Diagram
Has Self Adhesive Backing
Comes with Adhesive Pre-applied but additional adhesive may need to be applied on bottom of strip if the hardtop is to be taken on and off.
NOTE:
Please look carefully at this item to verify that it will fit on your particular Brand & Style of Hardtop.
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – #11 Rubber Seal
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985- 1995 Soft Top
Suzuki SJ410 1980- 1984 Soft Top
